scripts.install: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && cd backend && npx prisma generate && cd .. && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && npx tsx prisma/enrich-demo-data.ts && npm start
